decisive_items: Decreased size of the cardiac allograft
Further size remodeling of the cardiac allograft
response.rationale: R1 is champion due to its strong support from multiple imaging studies showing changes in cardiac allograft size and relief of compression on surrounding structures, while R6 is runner-up due to its focus on a specific anatomic localization (compression of the left bronchus) without addressing the underlying cause of the compression

rejected.why: R4 is rejected due to its lack of direct evidence supporting LVAD thrombosis as the primary cause of the patient's symptoms
